item.title: Shear line causes flooding, landslides and class suspensions in Agusan del Sur
item.description: TANDAG CITY (MindaNews / 20 February) — Heavy rains brought by a shear line have disrupted travel, caused flooding and prompted province-wide class suspensions in Agusan del Sur. Governor Santiago B. Cane Jr. suspended classes at all levels, both public and private, across the province due to the risk of flash floods and rain-induced landslides. […]
